name: UGC Talking Head
description: One real-looking person talks straight into their phone: hook, proof, CTA. Casts an actor, generates a master first frame, derives every beat's frame from that same frame so the face never changes, then drives image-to-video with a model that speaks natively. The default for founder/owner testimonial content.

hook.description: The first line spoken to camera. Max 14 words, must earn the next 2 seconds.

beats.description: 2-3 short spoken beats after the hook, as a list of strings.

presenter.description: Casting note, e.g. 'woman, 30s, cafe owner, apron, warm and dry'.

value.frame: Shot on an iPhone front-facing camera, handheld selfie angle, vertical 9:16, photorealistic. Realistic skin texture with visible pores across the nose and cheeks, natural slight unevenness, faint freckles and peach fuzz, natural skin sheen, no beauty filter, no airbrushing. Natural window light from one side, soft uneven shadows, available room light only. Casual clothing with real wrinkles and creases. Lived-in cluttered background with specific everyday objects. Slightly imperfect off-centre framing, mild phone-lens distortion, subtle digital noise and grain. Candid unposed moment, authentic amateur TikTok still.
value.motion: Keep the exact same person, hair, wardrobe, room and framing as the reference image. Handheld phone camera feel, slight unsteady framing and micro-shake. Natural micro-movements: blinking, small head tilts, breathing, fabric shifting. The person speaks directly into the front-facing camera. Continuous authentic phone footage, no cuts, no camera moves beyond handheld drift.
value.negative: studio lighting, three-point lighting, perfect symmetry, cinematic colour grade, airbrushed skin, plastic skin, waxy skin, beauty filter, CGI, 3D render, stock photo, model headshot, polished commercial look, watermark, text overlay, subtitles, extra fingers, warped hands

nodes.system: You cast and direct short-form UGC video. You write people who look like real customers filming themselves, never like models in an advert. You are specific and grounded: a named age, real features, a real room with real clutter. You write dialogue how people actually talk — contractions, no marketing register, one breath per line.

schema.actor: one paragraph pinning down age, build, hair, face, exact clothing and the specific room
schema.master_frame_prompt: still-image prompt for the neutral opening frame

shots.frame_prompt: edit instruction from the master frame
shots.motion_prompt: action and delivery, with the spoken line in quotes

nodes.prompt:
{{shot.frame_prompt}}

Preserve the person's identity, facial structure, hair, wardrobe, room and lighting from the reference image exactly. Change only expression, head angle and framing.
